overall: The AG found the Advisory Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law by meeting in executive session under Purpose 3 on September 8, 2022 to discuss approving fund transfers for litigation settlements. It declined to review the September 20 and 22 sessions, which lacked a formal complaint.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee met in executive session on September 8, 2022 without a proper purpose, to discuss litigation settlements needing Reserve or Liability Fund transfers.

allegations.key_passage: Because no formal complaint has been filed concerning the propriety of the September 20 or 22 executive sessions, we decline to formally review their propriety here.
